exposure: Group prenatal care (GPNC) participation (specifically 5 or more sessions of CenteringPregnancy GPNC)
outcome: Well-child visit (WCV) attendance (specifically attending 6 or more WCVs)
cohort: Infants whose births were covered by Medicaid in South Carolina, whose mothers either participated in CenteringPregnancy GPNC or received individual prenatal care between 2013-2018.
finding: Participation in 5 or more Group Prenatal Care (GPNC) sessions was associated with modestly higher rates of well-child visit (WCV) compliance over the first 15 months compared to individual prenatal care.
birth_weight: Low birthweight infants were a subgroup for whom stronger associations between GPNC and WCV attendance were observed.
